boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct library study environments on Northwestern’s Evanston campus, spanning quiet reading rooms, open seating, and reservable project spaces.

cards.title: 1 South
cards.subtitle: University Library, Level 1 South Tower
cards.notes: Set up for a group work session in this open study area, then reserve a project room when your team needs a dedicated workspace.
cards.short_summary: Open group study space with reservable project rooms and whiteboards.
cards.evidence_claim: Northwestern lists 1 South as an open group study space with reservable project rooms and whiteboard features.
cards.access_notes: Located in University Library; project rooms are reservable.

cards.title: Core
cards.subtitle: University Library, Level 2 Core
cards.notes: Use the Level 2 Core when you want open seating and a group-oriented setting without booking a room in advance.
cards.short_summary: Open Level 2 seating designated for group study.
cards.evidence_claim: Northwestern lists the Core as open seating in University Library’s Level 2 Core with a group-study-space feature.
cards.access_notes: Open seating in University Library; no reservation is listed for the Core.

cards.title: Core Project Room (2N)
cards.subtitle: University Library, Level 2 North Tower
cards.notes: Reserve this medium project room for a focused team session, especially when a shared table and enclosed meeting setup help.
cards.evidence_claim: Northwestern lists Core Project Room (2N) in the Level 2 North Tower as a medium, reservable group study space.
cards.access_notes: Reservation is required; located in University Library’s Level 2 North Tower.

cards.title: Project Room C (1S)
cards.subtitle: University Library, Level 1 South Tower
cards.notes: Book this room for a working meeting that benefits from a large table, rolling chairs, and a wireless display monitor.
cards.short_summary: Reservable project room with a large table and Solstice monitor.
cards.evidence_claim: Northwestern identifies Project Room C as a Level 1 South Tower room with a large table, six rolling chairs, and a Solstice wireless monitor.
cards.access_notes: Reservable as 1 South Project Room C.

cards.title: Third Floor Towers
cards.subtitle: University Library, Level 3
cards.notes: Bring independent work to the third-floor towers when a quiet open-seating environment is a better fit than a group room.
cards.short_summary: Quiet open seating across University Library’s third-floor towers.
cards.evidence_claim: Northwestern lists the Third Floor Towers at University Library Level 3 as open seating with a quiet feature.
cards.access_notes: Open seating in University Library’s Level 3 towers.

cards.title: Periodicals and Newspapers Reading Room
cards.subtitle: University Library, Level 1
cards.notes: Choose this Level 1 reading room for solo coursework when you want a library-designated quiet study area with tables and chairs.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet-study reading room on Level 1.
cards.evidence_claim: Northwestern identifies the Periodicals and Newspapers reading room on University Library Level 1 as one of its quiet study spaces.
cards.access_notes: A University Library quiet-study area with tables and chairs.

cards.title: Deering 213
cards.subtitle: Deering Library, Level 2
cards.notes: Head to Deering 213 for individual reading or writing when you need a quiet designated study area away from group work.
cards.short_summary: Designated quiet study space in Deering Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Northwestern lists Deering 213 on Level 2 among the Libraries’ quiet study spaces.
cards.access_notes: Located in Deering Library on Level 2; quiet-study areas have tables and chairs.

cards.title: Martin Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Deering Library, Level 3
cards.notes: Use the Martin Reading Room for a quiet individual study block, with the library’s Level 3 setting built around reading-room work.
cards.evidence_claim: Northwestern identifies the Martin Reading Room on Deering Library Level 3 as a quiet study space.
cards.access_notes: Located in Deering Library on Level 3; quiet-study areas have tables and chairs.

cards.title: Architecture Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Deering Library, Level 3
cards.notes: Settle into the Architecture Reading Room for quiet independent work, using the Level 3 reading-room setting for a concentrated session.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet-study reading room in Deering Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Northwestern lists the Architecture Reading Room on Deering Library Level 3 among its quiet study spaces.
cards.access_notes: Located in Deering Library on Level 3; quiet-study areas have tables and chairs.

cards.title: North Study Lounge
cards.subtitle: Mudd Library, second floor
cards.notes: Work quietly in Mudd’s North Study Lounge, then use the building’s study-room reservations if your project needs private space.
cards.short_summary: A quiet-study lounge in the technology-focused Mudd Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Northwestern identifies the North Study Lounge on Mudd Library’s second floor as a quiet study space; Mudd also offers open and reservable study spaces.
cards.access_notes: Mudd is on the second floor of Mudd Hall; after-hours access requires an active Northwestern Wildcard.
